description: Returns one EU contract award notice from official TED by its publication number: winners, buyer, value, CPV, dates, lots, notice URL and SHA-256 proof. Use it when you already have a notice_id; use awards_list_contracts to discover awards or filter by company, CPV or country. Input: notice_id (required, TED publication number, 1 to 8 digits, hyphen, year, e.g. 718666-2026). Output: award and feed (coverage, checked_at). A notice we have not stored returns award_not_found; awards_feed_not_ready means the feed is not loaded yet. Reads stored observations (about 45 days), not a live TED lookup. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors and empty answers are free. An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.
name: awards_get_contract
title: Get one EU contract award
